test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 04 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Which of the following options is the most suitable conversion of the following sentence into Passive Voice?

Someone is bound to notice your absence.

options.text: Your absence is bound to be noticed.
Your absence is bound to be noticed by everyone.
Your absence is bound to notice by someone.
Your absence is bound to be notice.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.
 
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "Someone is bound to notice your absence."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "your absence" at the beginning.
